svg.title: AGENT-O: core relationships for engineering review
svg.desc: Selected relationships verified against the six current AGENT-O ontology modules. Solid arrows are object properties; dashed hollow arrows are subclass relationships.
svg.text: A modular ontology for representing, evaluating and governing health-oriented agent systems
Object property: a link between instances

g.text: A System, model and document identities
Namespaces: core + doc | Composition, functional roles, reusable model resources and runtime access

svg.text: System membership does not imply agency. A configured system need not have past execution runs.

g.text: Namespace: eval | Study, target and result

svg.text: Targets can include systems, models and workflows.
Plans and capabilities are distinct from actual events.

g.text: Namespace: report | Assessment of a publication

svg.text: Reading guide: boxes denote classes. Solid arrows show selected links between instances; they do not impose universal existence or cardinality.
Repeated boxes denote the same class. Panel grouping is explanatory. This overview omits detailed classes, constraints and external alignments.
Prepared 2026-11-05 from the six current authoritative modules; includes the 2026-10-29 semantic revisions.
